P01.name: Health-tech admission
P01.guarantee: Admitted work has a documented healthcare purpose and a technology, informatics or health-AI contribution.

P02.name: Regional role admission
P02.guarantee: An admitted regional work claim requires an affirmative regional creator-role decision.

P03.name: Temporal attribution
P03.guarantee: Dated attribution uses half-open intervals; an expired or unknown-current assertion cannot establish current presence.

P04.name: Publication authority
P04.guarantee: Model output alone cannot authorize a public work claim.

P05.name: Independent source channels
P05.guarantee: Each admitted source class can qualify independently of source platform.

P06.name: No repository prerequisite
P06.guarantee: A valid publication, preprint or discussion does not require a repository or project grouping.

P07.name: No name-only identity merge
P07.guarantee: A matching name is insufficient for an identity merge.

P08.name: Typed identities
P08.guarantee: Person, account and organization identities cannot be silently merged across kinds.

P09.name: Replay idempotence
P09.guarantee: Replaying the same stable source identity does not create another identity in the retained set.

P10.name: Evidence retention
P10.guarantee: A failed refresh preserves retained evidence and cannot establish a new healthy observation.

P11.name: Evidence-head guard
P11.guarantee: A current public projection cannot commit against a different retained evidence head.

P12.name: Supported relation endpoints
P12.guarantee: A public relation requires an admitted relation and available admitted endpoints.

P13.name: Reuse claims
P13.guarantee: Unknown or restricted license evidence cannot create an unrestricted-reuse claim.

P14.name: Public field projection
P14.guarantee: Public display is restricted to admitted public fields; internal candidate fields stay outside the projection.

P15.name: Query admission
P15.guarantee: Every query result belongs to the admitted snapshot and satisfies the selected filters.

P16.name: Filter algebra
P16.guarantee: OR within a selected facet and AND across facets are deterministic, commutative and idempotent.

P17.name: Strict total ordering
P17.guarantee: The declared sort key gives a strict total order when stable tie identities are distinct.

P18.name: Sort transitivity
P18.guarantee: The lexicographic comparator is transitive for all declared integer key coordinates.

P19.name: Date integrity
P19.guarantee: Changing ingestion time alone cannot improve a source-event-date sort key. Unknown dates remain explicit.

P20.name: Cursor binding
P20.guarantee: A continuation is rejected when its snapshot, normalized query or sort mode changes.

P21.name: Pagination partition
P21.guarantee: Positive-size keyset pages partition a fixed finite ordered snapshot without duplicates or omissions.

P22.name: Request budget
P22.guarantee: A guarded atomic request counter cannot exceed its declared run budget.

P23.name: Byte budget
P23.guarantee: A guarded append cannot retain more than its declared byte budget.

P24.name: Conditional round-robin fairness
P24.guarantee: Every member of a fixed nonempty eligible source cohort has a slot in one complete round.

P25.name: Nonvacuous coverage
P25.guarantee: An empty enrollment or an incomplete, failed or truncated check set cannot claim completed enrolled-scope coverage.

P26.name: Cohort accounting
P26.guarantee: Within one retained cohort, published membership is contained in admitted membership and captured membership.

P27.name: Project grouping
P27.guarantee: A project relationship needs admitted relationship evidence; shared titles alone cannot establish grouping.

P28.name: Policy-head guard
P28.guarantee: A changed geography, relevance or review-policy head invalidates current-projection status until readmission.

P29.name: Lifecycle safety
P29.guarantee: All states reachable under the declared abstract transitions preserve admission and retained-evidence invariants.

P30.name: Operational paths
P30.guarantee: The explicit finite workflows retain typed declarations, consistent obligations and supported completion paths, including holds.

P31.name: Exact nine-county policy
P31.guarantee: The admitted county relation is exactly the selected nine-county set; unknown or outside keys cannot satisfy membership.

P32.name: Corroboration deduplication
P32.guarantee: Repeating evidence from the same admitted provenance origin cannot increase the distinct-origin set.

assumptions.A_FACTS: The decision inputs mean what their evidence and reviewer assert. Mathematical consistency does not establish their truth.
assumptions.A_GEO: The user-selected county set is authoritative. Professional-location and creator-role evidence are correctly interpreted and dated.
assumptions.A_TIME: Source times and intervals have been normalized correctly. Freshness policy is explicit; an unknown end date is not proof of a current relationship.
assumptions.A_AUTHORITY: Human or deterministic-rule authority is authenticated outside the mathematical gate. The model-output role has no such authority.
assumptions.A_PROVIDER: Source access and enrollment are qualified per installation. An API description does not establish actual regional coverage or complete metadata.
assumptions.A_IDENTITY: Admitted equivalence and relationship evidence is correctly adjudicated. Names and similarity are discovery leads only.
assumptions.A_KEYS: Canonical provider/native identifiers and stable tie identities are correctly assigned; persistent uniqueness guards reject collisions.
assumptions.A_STORAGE: The storage implementation preserves committed immutable evidence and distinguishes observations from source failures.
assumptions.A_ATOMIC: The modeled guard and mutation occur atomically, or an equivalent transaction/CAS guard protects the implementation.
assumptions.A_SCHEMA: The selected public-field allowlist and field-level evidence admission are correct and enforced by the eventual projection.
assumptions.A_SNAPSHOT: A result snapshot is immutable, finite and canonically identified. The actual normalized query is compared, not only a collision-prone digest.
assumptions.A_QUERY: Facet values and query terms have already been normalized according to the selected exact matching rules.
assumptions.A_ORDER: Sort coordinates use exact integers and the selected direction. Stable tie identity is unique within the snapshot.
assumptions.A_FAIRNESS: The eligible cohort and cursor order are fixed for the round, dispatch continues, and each attempt advances the cursor. Permanent outages do not imply delivery.
assumptions.A_COVERAGE: Counts refer to the same declared source scope, window or candidate cohort. They do not describe an unknown global population.
assumptions.A_TRANSITIONS: Only the explicitly declared abstract transitions occur. Correspondence to native descriptions and future code requires separate review and tests.
assumptions.A_ORIGIN: Provenance-origin equivalence is correctly assigned. Distinct URLs do not themselves establish independent sources.

not_mathematically_established.E01: Who actually has the claimed regional professional connection, including missing or stale public profiles.
not_mathematically_established.E02: Whether a work contribution is truly relevant to the intended health-tech audience.
not_mathematically_established.E03: Regional recall and which people or work remain undiscovered.
not_mathematically_established.E04: Provider access, source permission, metadata completeness and ongoing availability.
not_mathematically_established.E05: Whether ranking, summaries and presentation help readers make useful discoveries.
not_mathematically_established.E06: Whether the eventual Worker, database, adapters and UI faithfully implement the formal contracts.
